scope: Actual neutral mesh replay of already exposed K2 calibration results; no refitting, model selection, new inference, formal training or independent quality acceptance

geometry.definition: float64 u + first40 w_shp * saved shape, plus frozen fold displacement; expression neutral, interleaved XYZ order preserved
geometry.frame: Every source, reconstructed target reference and prediction uses the immutable original source center/scale from K1; never normalize a target or prediction independently
geometry.reference: Same-person reconstructed neutral target is a fitting proxy, never measured 3D ground truth
geometry.same_age: For each selected source, all three routes must return the original coefficient object and exact original GLB bytes
geometry.winding: BFM ordered faces a,b,c become a,c,b, matching the existing canonical exporter
